title: when the paper makes a claim but the source trail is missing
caption: When a paper makes a claim but the source trail is messy, I check where the evidence actually comes from first.
pinned_comment: Would you check the claim first or the reference list first?
script_lines: when the paper makes a claim but I cannot find where it came from
so I open Citely instead of guessing
paste the claim from the paper
then it pulls up papers connected to that claim
finally I have a source trail to check before I cite it
